name: Claude Code 2.1.262 — Workflow Tool Shrinks 5.7k→1k Tokens + Settings Fixes
hook: The Workflow tool's built-in description is down from 5,700 to ~1,000 tokens — a 4,700-token saving on every session that uses it — after Anthropic moved the script-writing reference into a bundled `workflow-authoring` skill. name: `ant apply` v1.30.0 — Terraform-Style IaC for Claude Managed Agents
hook: Version 1.30.0 of the `ant` CLI (September 3) adds `ant apply`: describe agents, environments, skills, memory stores, and deployments as declarative files, run `ant apply`, review the plan, and approve — much like Terraform for Claude API resources. A `claude-lock.json` lockfile tracks resources across runs for safe incremental updates. AlphaSignal flagged it as 'Anthropic Ships Terraform-Style Workflow to Deploy Claude Agents From Code.'

name: DietrichGebert/ponytail — 128.6K Stars; Laziness Ladder Cuts Code 54–94%
hook: 128,600 stars — up ~24K since last featured August 19. Ponytail enforces a 7-rung laziness ladder before writing a single line of custom code: stdlib first, native platform features, existing dependencies, one-liners, and so on. Benchmarked at ~54% less generated code (range up to 94%), ~20% cheaper API spend, and ~27% faster completions on real FastAPI + React sessions. Targets code bloat; caveman targets prose verbosity — both are complementary.
